description: Fast Windows file manager with tabs, previews, full-computer search, and optional Explorer integration.

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller)) { throw 'Prime Files Inno Setup uninstaller was not found; refusing to remove files without vendor cleanup.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Prime Files uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }

notes: The official per-user installer may install the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime and, on Windows N editions, enable Media Feature Pack (a restart may be required). Optional instant indexing installs the PrimeFilesIndexer service only when enabled in the app. Prime Files has its own automatic updater and can update its installed files independently of Scoop's version tracking.
